records.title: Consilience: Conformally Calibrated Communication Control for Hidden-Profile Multi-Agent Reasoning
records.read_depth: Abstract, sections3.1.3 and AppendixA, held-out subsectionC.1 and assignment analysisD
records.summary: The method evaluates all admissible counterfactual branches for its realized surrogate regret. Its round-wise conformal statement requires exchangeability under the fixed deployed policy; it is neither final-answer correctness nor simultaneous trajectory coverage. The committed branch must not be resampled. Hidden-profile communication and action routing are close prior art. Our potential distinction must be measured savings in limited feedback after graph changes, with all counterfactual costs counted; no such advantage is established.
records.relevance: Direct novelty and full-cost boundary; conformal intervals are not added to MAB2.
